extension_field_transfer.rank_invariance: All source matrices have entries in F2; a nonzero minor remains nonzero and zero minors remain zero under every characteristic-two extension.
extension_field_transfer.distance_argument: If an extended codeword had support<48, its >63 zero coordinates give a rank<9 punctured generator matrix; extension rank invariance yields a nonzero binary codeword with the same zero coordinates, contradicting binary distance48.
extension_field_transfer.availability_argument: For binary h and each binary restriction matrix, rowspace membership over an extension is equivalent to equality of ranks of binary augmented matrices, hence to base-field membership.
extension_field_transfer.coordinate_coset_negative_control: For h=e1+e10, h+c e_l is nonzero with support<=3 for every extension scalar c and every l; it cannot be in the extended code of distance48.

proof_audit.gluing_scope: Pair-difference relations force a global q only when the available binary normals span rank>=3.
proof_audit.dependent_normal_handling: For any extra normal a, at least two of an independent triple remain independent modulo span(a); intersecting the corresponding spans(a,a_i) therefore leaves only span(a), including when a is a selected normal or a dependent sum.
proof_audit.rank2_exception: Three distinct nonzero normals 01,10,11 can satisfy all pairwise relations without one global q; this prevents extending the gluing lemma to rank2 by assertion.
proof_audit.main_bound: For any nonzero noncoordinate coset, availability<=36. A coset with>=37 available normals has rank>=3, glues to a representative supported in the common closed neighborhood; two support coordinates force availability<=36, so only a single-coordinate coset remains.

scope: Scalar characteristic-two fields, the pinned actual code C+span(h), and its vertex-gauge equivalent only. No arbitrary rank-ten space or entangled operator extension.
